# Growthryders

> Growthryders (GRY) is a brand activation and through-the-line marketing company based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. One team plans and runs activations, experiential marketing, media, corporate events, digital marketing and technology-led experiences.

## Services
- [Brand activations and TTL marketing](https://growthryders.in/services.html#activations): Consumer engagement on the ground, amplified across every channel that reaches the same people. Includes: Corporate park activations, Mall and public space promotions, Product sampling, Roadshows, Campus and residential activations, Brand launches.
- [Digital marketing](https://growthryders.in/services.html#digital): Search, social, content, websites and performance campaigns that keep the conversation going. Includes: SEO and GEO, Performance marketing, Social media management, Content creation, Website design and development, Lead generation.
- [Experiential marketing](https://growthryders.in/services.html#experiential): Launches, installations and interactive formats that turn communication into something people remember. Includes: Product launches, Trade shows and exhibitions, Immersive brand storytelling, Employee and partner engagement.
- [Media solutions](https://growthryders.in/services.html#media): Planning and buying across outdoor, transit, print, radio, corporate parks, malls and retail. Includes: Outdoor and digital outdoor, Transit and airport media, Print and radio, Corporate park media, Mall and retail media.
- [Corporate events and engagement](https://growthryders.in/services.html#events): Conferences, dealer meets, summits, awards and employee programmes, concept to close. Includes: Conferences and annual meets, Dealer meets, Leadership summits, Awards, Employee engagement programmes.
- [Technology-led experiences](https://growthryders.in/services.html#experiential): Installations, AR and VR, gamification and interactive digital formats built into the activation. Includes: Technology-led installations, Augmented and virtual reality, Gamification, Interactive digital experiences.

TVS Apache, Royal Enfield, Bagmane REIT, Axis Bank, Milky Mist, Kauvery Hospital, Protein Chef, iRaces

## Questions and answers
- What does Growthryders do? Growthryders is a brand activation agency and through-the-line marketing company based in Bengaluru (Bangalore). One team plans and runs brand activations, experiential marketing, media, corporate events, digital marketing and technology-led experiences.
- Where is Growthryders based? Growthryders is based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India.
- What kinds of brand activations does Growthryders run? Corporate park activations, mall and public space promotions, product sampling, roadshows, campus and residential activations, and brand launches.
- Which services does Growthryders offer? Brand activations and TTL marketing; Digital marketing; Experiential marketing; Media solutions; Corporate events and engagement; Technology-led experiences.
- Which brands has Growthryders been on the ground with? TVS Apache, Royal Enfield, Bagmane REIT, Axis Bank, Milky Mist, Kauvery Hospital, Protein Chef and iRaces.
- What are Runcle and Bikers Bay? They are platforms Growthryders owns. Runcle is a fitness and wellness platform where running meets cycling, for runners, cyclists and corporate teams. Bikers Bay is a motorcycle community with rides, meets and brand collaborations.
- How do I start a project with Growthryders? Call +91 99005 65911, message on WhatsApp at +91 81973 30612, or email surender@growthryders.in.
